name: neuro
description: neuro web prototype prepared for Capacitor iOS packaging.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:web
scripts.test:unit: node tests/judge.test.mjs && node tests/pointing.test.mjs && node tests/crane-geometry.test.mjs && node tests/reaction.test.mjs && node tests/art-quality.test.mjs && node tests/personal-best.test.mjs && node tests/rhythm-params.test.mjs && node tests/session-conditions.test.mjs && node tests/offset-distribution.test.mjs && node tests/scan-paging.test.mjs && node tests/effect-gain.test.mjs && node tests/session-trend.test.mjs && node tests/difficulty-mode.test.mjs && node tests/i18n.test.mjs && node tests/readiness-check.test.mjs && node tests/data-integrity.test.mjs
scripts.test:web: npm run build && node tests/web-smoke.mjs && node tests/pwa-update-race.mjs
scripts.test:web:headed: npm run build && node tests/web-smoke.mjs --headed && node tests/pwa-update-race.mjs --headed
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
